name: nexchat
description: NexChat — E2EE (MLS) IM web client for the Nexus chat pallets

scripts.relay:pinner: cd relay-rs && cargo run --release -p relay-pinners --bin pinner-hot
scripts.relay:chain-pinner: cd relay-rs && cargo run --release -p relay-pinners --bin pinner-chain --features chain
scripts.relay:crust-pinner: cd relay-rs && cargo run --release -p relay-pinners --bin pinner-crust
scripts.relay:restore: bash -c 'set -a && source relay-ops/relay-backup.env && set +a && bash scripts/relay-restore-from-ipfs.sh'
scripts.mls:build: cd mls-wasm && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=./target cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir ../src/mls-pkg --out-name nexchat_mls target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/deps/nexchat_mls.wasm
scripts.dr:build: cd dr-wasm && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=./target cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir ../src/dr-pkg --out-name nexchat_dr target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/nexchat_dr.wasm
scripts.dr:verify: npm run dr:build && git diff --exit-code -- src/dr-pkg/
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:cap && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:sync:remote: CAP_SERVER_URL=${CAP_SERVER_URL:-https://nexusmall.net/nexchat/} npm run build:cap && CAP_SERVER_URL=${CAP_SERVER_URL:-https://nexusmall.net/nexchat/} npx cap sync android
scripts.android:release:remote: npm run android:sync:remote && npm run android:apk
scripts.deploy:apk: test -f android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk || (echo 'Run npm run android:apk first' && exit 1)
